name: rlm-pdk-ots
instr:
The repository at `/workdir` is rlm (Recursive Language Models), a Python inference library in which a
language model answers a prompt by writing and running Python code in a REPL environment: `RLM.completion()`
drives a root model through iterations of code execution in an environment (a local in-process REPL by
default, or Docker, Modal, E2B, Daytona and Prime sandboxes) where the prompt is available as a variable and
the code can make recursive sub-calls to language models.

Fix all implementation drift from the documentation in this repository.
Everything in scope is the rlm Python package under rlm/ (its RLM core, LM clients, REPL environments, logger and utilities), together with README.md, the documentation pages docs/getting-started.md, docs/architecture.md and docs/api/rlm.md, the documentation site's sources under docs/src/, and the module, class and function docstrings of the in-scope modules.

Where the code and the documentation disagree about runtime behavior, the documentation is the
authority: change the implementation so that it does what the documentation says, and do not edit
or delete documentation to make a disagreement go away. The documentation is those pages and the
in-package docstrings, including their examples; in-package code comments are only supporting
evidence, and when a comment conflicts with the documentation, follow the documentation.

The environment runs Python 3.11 with rlm's dependencies, including every optional extra, installed and
